concept: A massive wall or barrier made of fractured glass and concrete blocks, fragmenting and shattering outward from a central point of impact. Dark grays and blacks dominate, with red cracks spreading like fissures. The composition is explosive and destabilizing, with jagged shards suspended mid-fall. The style is brutalist and stark, emphasizing rupture, breaking of norms, and systems under strain. Heavy, ominous shadows. No figures—only the abstract violence of structures collapsing inward and outward simultaneously.
explanation: Today's headlines depict systems under assault: territorial annexation threats, media suppression, AI security breaches, intensifying cyberattacks and missile threats, violence against vulnerable populations, and fundamental errors of institutional competence. These are not isolated incidents but a pattern of boundaries being crossed, safeguards failing, and the social contract fragmenting. The overarching emotion is one of instability and erosion—not in any single headline, but in their collective weight and the sense that established rules and protections are simultaneously cracking from external pressure and internal failure.

headlines.title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
headlines.summary: Trump says the agreement will give the US "permanent control over security, and all other needs, in Greenland", though specifics have not been confirmed by Danish officials.

headlines.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
headlines.summary: The US president has had a tense and fiery relationship with the US media throughout his political career.

headlines.title: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
headlines.summary: The AI model accessed the internet and guessed credentials to three websites, a Google official told the BBC.

headlines.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
headlines.summary: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

headlines.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
headlines.summary: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

headlines.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
headlines.summary: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

headlines.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
headlines.summary: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh since Houthis escalated attacks
headlines.summary: Residents later received the all-clear after explosions were reported in the capital.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
headlines.summary: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

headlines.title: Shots heard as police start moving migrants from Ceuta beaches
headlines.summary: Police reportedly fired into the air on Friday morning as they struggled to contain crowds jostling to secure a place at the tented site.

headlines.title: Ryanair boss Michael O'Leary apologises over 'high-fare rapists' remarks
headlines.summary: O'Leary described his choice of language as "careless" and said "it won't happen again".

headlines.title: North Korean anthem played for South Korea at Asian Games
headlines.summary: Organisers have apologised for playing the North Korean national anthem for the South Korean men's hockey team at the Asian Games in Japan.
